title: The Clean Ghost
author: Cyrus Sterling
blurb: Kestrel Okonkwo, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
